title: Materials Chemist / Scientist - replacing Teflon/PFAS
description: Nanize AS, based in Narvik, Norway and established in 2019, is developing technologies for replacement of Teflon/PFAS in many application areas. Current commercial efforts are focused on cookware/bakeware, release liners, technical fabrics and membranes and packaging, among others. Nanize has a 400m2 lab in Narvik …
